## @interlace/slider

Installed to `components/ui/slider.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/slider';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/slider

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
